subject.title: bug: Duplicate messages sent to Slack

question: Can a maintainer or operator correlate session agent:main:slack:channel:c0at0fztn85 with gateway delivery logs and Slack message IDs to identify the exact duplicate-delivery path?
rationale: The necessary evidence lives outside the repository; source inspection only proves adjacent guards, not the root cause for the reported duplicate Slack messages.

options.title: Keep Open For Log-Backed Triage
options.body: Request or inspect gateway logs plus Slack timestamps/message IDs before closing or promoting a code fix.

options.title: Close Against A Matched Shipped Fix
options.body: Close only if logs show the duplicate was one of the already-shipped guarded classes in v2026.6.11 or earlier.

options.title: Promote A Focused Fix After Isolation
options.body: Queue a fix PR only after the logs identify one concrete Slack delivery path and a focused regression target.
